P1.1.text: Innoviva – Healthcare Royalty and Asset Management

P1.2.text: Innoviva manages a respiratory royalty portfolio and makes strategic acquisitions in promising areas of unmet need, such as infectious diseases.

P1.3.text: Innoviva is fueling healthcare innovation by investing in areas of high unmet medical need as well as developing and commercializing differentiated therapies.

P1.4.text: We are a diversified biopharmaceutical company with a core royalties portfolio, a leading critical care and infectious disease platform, and a portfolio of strategic investments in healthcare assets.

P1.5.text: It’s who we are. It’s our purpose. It’s our passion. It’s why we exist. It’s our name. We are Innoviva.

P1.6.text: Strongly cashflow-positive, durable core royalty business stemming from widely used respiratory products

P1.7.text: Commercial stage, fast-growth critical care and infectious disease platform

P1.8.text: High-potential, valuable diversified portfolio of healthcare assets offers optionality, downside protection, and long-term value creation

P1.9.text: Thoughtful, robust approach to capital deployment with long-term horizon

P1.10.text: Strong track record and value creation focus

P2.1.text: About Us - Our Core Values - Innoviva

P2.2.text: Innoviva effectives manages royalty portfolio and advances innovation in areas of high unmet medical need.

P2.3.text: Long live the innovators. We’re here to help – through thoughtful capital allocation and stewardship.

P2.4.text: Innoviva was originally formed to maximize the value of the royalty streams coming from respiratory products co-developed with and licensed to GSK.

P2.5.text: Incorporated in Delaware under the name Advanced Medicine, Inc.

P2.6.text: Changed its name to Theravance, Inc.

P2.12.text: Armata* and Innoviva announced strategic investment

P2.13.text: Entasis and Innoviva announced private placement

P2.14.text: Innoviva announced strategic repurchase of GSK’s equity stake

P2.15.text: Sold 15% stake in Theravance Respiratory Company**

P2.16.text: Announced integration of Entasis and La Jolla into Innoviva Specialty Therapeutics

P2.17.text: Announced successful zoliflodacin Phase III results in uncomplicated gonorrhea

P2.19.text: XACDURO ® and ZEVTERA ® nominated for 2025 Prix Galien USA Award

P2.21.text: *Currently with greater than 50% equity ownership and significant warrant coverage by Innoviva

P2.23.text: We believe in the power of partnership and inclusiveness, and that the best ideas can come from anywhere in the room. Together we are always better.

P2.24.text: We take the long view and focus our efforts.

P2.25.text: ACT WITH INTEGRITY, EVERY DAY IN EVERY WAY.

P2.26.text: We believe in transparency, honesty, and trust. A genuine desire to do what’s right will always be what defines us as a team and guides us on our journey.

P2.27.text: MAKE OUR MARK BY MAKING A DIFFERENCE.

P2.28.text: We believe the world will become a better place when we fuse our expertise, resources, and ambition with our passion for making a positive, lasting impact on people’s lives.

P2.29.text: We believe in dreaming big, acting quickly and taking risks in line with our conviction yet managing them well.

P1.3.text: Making a difference by challenging the status quo

P1.4.text: Advancing new hope for people with kidney disease

P1.5.text: A trusted leader in the renal community delivering unique products to people with kidney disease.

P1.6.text: We are a fully integrated biopharmaceutical company. Our team works to address complications of kidney disease. We have two FDA-approved products.

P1.7.text: Be part of a passionate team working to protect the kidneys and to innovate for better lives

P2.2.text: We work to develop novel therapeutics that have the potential to set new standards of care for people living with kidney disease.

P2.3.text: Our team is bold and optimistic.

P2.4.text: Since our founding we’ve put tenacity and innovation to work to develop unique therapeutics that have the potential to set new standards of care for people living with kidney disease. We have emerged as a leader with deep roots in the renal community. Today, we are a fully integrated biopharmaceutical company with an experienced nephrology-focused commercial team with a robust development organization, and partners around the globe. We currently have two FDA-approved products.

P2.6.text: At Akebia, we are all in on our purpose – to better the life of each person impacted by kidney disease.

P2.7.text: We know that big change is possible when we work together, within Akebia and well beyond our four walls. We collaborate with members of the medical and biopharmaceutical communities, as well as patient organizations.

P2.8.text: We are located in the biotech hub of Kendall Square in Cambridge, Massachusetts, where we are inspired by our peers and dedicated to working with our partners, patients, advocacy organizations and the broader renal community to better the life of each person impacted by kidney disease.
